question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: Here the correct answer is **Concerns**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**concerns**'. • It means **'a feeling of worry; something that causes worry'. **(चिंता; परवाह; चिंताजनक बात) • *Example: The safety officer assured us that there was no cause for **concern**.* • The man felt that the school principal was incompetent because he was busy with irrelevant things like all window shades should be at the same level, the classrooms should be quiet and the rose beds should not be stepped on. • **Concerns **will be used because the principal's main causes of worry were irrelevant things like the ones mentioned in the above line. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3**. Correct Paragraph:__* "During my first year of teaching, I was quite (1) __upset__ to find that the school principal, supervisor and teachers (2) __appeared__ to be unaware of their professional responsibilities and (3) __incompetent__ in executing their duties. For example, my principal's main (4) **__concerns__ **were that all window shades be at the same (5) ________, the classrooms be quiet and the rose beds should not be stepped upon."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Options**: something that you can choose to do; the freedom to choose. (विकल्‍प; चयन की स्‍वतंत्रता) • **Benefits**: an advantage or useful effect that something has. (लाभ, हित, फ़ायदा) • **Choices**: an act of choosing between two or more people or things. (दो या दो से अधिक व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के मध्य चुनने की क्रिया; चयन, वरण) 4b:Te64, The correct answer is '**level**'.
